boundedQuestion: When third-party teacher code remains in the delivered Weather candidate, can source comments and an unlinked README alone support removing the rendered teacher/reference disclosure?
selectionReason: R50/R51 intentionally changed the user-facing provenance layer while retaining third-party code and notices. This is a live exact-subject risk; the motion README main-write was already content-reverted within two minutes and needs a separate incident receipt only if residual refs or policy gaps emerge.

teacherAudition.source: Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0 legal code + official attribution practices
teacherAudition.explicitNoveltyAnswer: It specifies that shared CC material must retain supplied creator/copyright/license/disclaimer/source information, indicate modifications, and present attribution in a manner reasonable for the medium and context. KAOPU already records source provenance, but did not separately gate the truthfulness of the rendered delivery surface.

screening.provenance: Official Creative Commons legal code and official CC attribution guide.
screening.maintenance: CC 4.0 is the current stable legal code; official guide remains maintained.
screening.reproducibility: No reference implementation is required; the exact disclosure fields can be replayed as deterministic fixtures.
screening.licenseAndRights: Official public license text used as normative evidence; no third-party asset bytes are imported.
screening.directRelevance: Directly governs the retained CC BY-NC-SA reference code and modification disclosure.
screening.novelty: Adds medium/context-dependent attribution plus explicit modification/source-link requirements to the source-vs-rendered truth comparison.
screening.integrationRisk: Legal sufficiency remains context-dependent; a visible link may be preferable to permanent UI text; localization and link integrity must be tested.
screening.antiDemoCheck: Not a marketing/demo source; canonical license and operational attribution guidance.

positiveControls: Compact UI with visible bound source/about link
negativeControls: R50 label removal with source comments retained
Visible label with missing source notice

decision.reason: The source layer is more truthful than the rendered layer. Retaining notices in code does not by itself make the user-facing claim semantically honest when the only teacher/reference markers are removed or hidden.

candidateTranslation.minimumTrial: Weather R51 only: expose a compact visible Sources/About control resolving to digest-bound creator/source/license/modification data; verify it in the rendered page; fail closed when missing, broken or mismatched.
